CustomField.label: Divider Icon
CustomField.description: SLDS icon name shown in the section divider when Field Set Show Divider is on. For non-Field-Set types it is passed as divider-icon-name to c-form-section-theme; for Field Set it is passed into c-flow-form's divider. Pairs with Divider Style (icon styles like ornament/bookmark show it).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: An SLDS icon to display in the divider, entered as category:name. It appears only with divider styles that support an icon, and requires the section divider to be enabled.
